slug: 2024-06-27 WURI digital ID project improving access to public services in Benin

facts.fact: The World Bank blog, via Biometric Update, says about 99 percent of Beninese citizens hold a legal and digital identity; the WURI project enrolled 2.2 million more people, 4,000 of them abroad. The share is of citizens and no total count is given.
